request.description: Exactly TWO pixel-art poses, BOTH facing LEFT AND AWAY toward the SAME TARGET. 192x96 transparent sheet, two96x96 cells. B's closed fist must extend beyond the LEFT edge of its torso, never toward the sheet's right edge. Same tiger head size, clothing, palette and native60px body scale in both. A: both knees bent deeply, hips sunken, wide planted staggered feet; body folded/coiled, RIGHT fist tightly behind WAIST and elbow back, opposite hand near front ribs. B: push from rear leg and step LEFT, front knee bent deeply, pelvis and shoulders rotate and drive LEFT behind the horizontally extended RIGHT arm. Lower torso and head into the strike. Right fist below eyes along shoulder line, left fist pulled back to waist. Both feet stay grounded far apart. Use actual mirrored photograph A/B body weight, but keep the tiger proportions/design and rear-three-quarter camera. Plain unmarked reddish-brown jacket back, EXACTLY like approved rotation: no tiger stripes, logos, embroidery or new patterns on the jacket. Fur stripes belong ONLY to orange fur, not fabric. Both poses facing LEFT, with connected closed fist LEFT of head at impact. Wide low compact stance, forward-loaded body. Clean transparent character pixels only, empty surroundings, no captions, no painted effects.
